# LurnStack

Interactive, live trainer-led online software engineering classes.

## Primary Sections

- [Home Page](https://lurnstack.com/): Interactive software training from professional developers.
- [Courses Catalog](https://lurnstack.com/courses): Live, developer-led classes in full stack development, Python, SQL, and UI/UX design.
- [Plans](https://lurnstack.com/plans): Tuition pricing, cohort schedules, and placement services.
- [About Us](https://lurnstack.com/about/company): Learn about the team of senior engineers and architects mentoring at LurnStack.

## Local SEO Pages

- [Software Courses in Chennai](https://lurnstack.com/software-courses-in-chennai): Directory of regional training programs across 65 local areas in Chennai.
